mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN stocktake_status = 'COUNTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS counted_count, SUM(CASE WHEN stocktake_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN stocktake_status = 'COUNTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS progress_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN diff_quantity > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS profit_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_quantity > 0 THEN diff_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS profit_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN diff_quantity < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN diff_quantity < 0 THEN ABS(diff_quantity) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loss_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(diff_quantity), 0) AS net_diff FROM wms_stocktake_order_item WHERE stocktake_order_id = #{stocktakeOrderId}
